title: Launch timeline snapshots and contextual callouts for release notes image pack
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Purpose: Produce a compact image asset pack for the upcoming release notes / changelog and quickstart guide that highlights product changes via a launch-timeline visual language and contextual callouts. The pack will include before/after UI comparison strips, timeline frames showing progressive onboarding steps, annotated callouts for new features, and multiple export sizes for blog, social, and in-app banners.

Deliverables: 1) Three before/after comparison strips (desktop, tablet, mobile) with pixel-perfect overlays and annotation layers. 2) Four timeline snapshot frames (intro, step1, step2, graduation) with consistent color tokens and CTA overlays. 3) Set of 8 contextual callout stickers (feature name + 1-line benefit) with background alpha. 4) Social-ready hero (1200x628) and blog header (1600x400) compositions. 5) Alt-text bank and copy-ready microcopy for each asset.

Technical specs: Source files in Figma; exports as PNG (lossless) and optimized WebP; SVG for simple icons and callouts. Desktop/comparison: 1440x400; Tablet: 1024x380; Mobile: 720x320. Timeline frames: 1200x600 and 600x300 variants. All assets include 2x retina exports. Naming convention: DES-41357_<asset-type>_<size>_<variant>. Example: DES-41357_beforeafter_desktop_v1.png.

Accessibility & localization: Provide plain-language alt-text for each asset and a short localization key file (en, fr, de). Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for callout text on backgrounds; provide dark-mode variants.

Stakeholders: PM (Aria Patel) for messaging, Engineering (ENG-5482) for feature screenshots, Content (Jon Ruiz) for microcopy, Growth for social sizes.

Usage guidance: Include a one-page README in Drive describing where each asset should be used (blog header, changelog carousel, quickstart modal, tweet card) and recommended copy pairings.
